architecture.proposal_and_role_heads: separate binary proposal and eight-role heads
architecture.scene_context: eight learned role queries pool permutation-invariant anchors over all proposals; each proposal then attends those anchors plus scene mean and maximum summaries

protocol.data_scope: fresh project-owned procedural graph scenes only; no Chandler, Generalization, private or article images, external datasets, pretrained calibrator weights, or predecessor fixture bytes
protocol.defect_class: aggregate V22 P3 removed every false and prohibited region but retained one missed truth and 24 role errors across the fixed visible selection
protocol.isolated_change: train a new project-owned role-anchor set model from scratch; learned role queries summarize the complete proposal set before each proposal is classified, replacing V22 all-proposal self-attention while retaining the frozen detector, recognizer, 31 evidence features, thresholds, and gates

training.proposal_objective: class-balanced cross entropy plus scene-extrema margin
training.role_objective: class-balanced cross entropy over every positive proposal
